name: double-entry-ledger
description: Double-entry bookkeeping for LLM-agent harnesses: runtime tool-call reconciliation with Claude Code hooks, and design-decision → code landing checks.

plugins.name: double-entry-ledger
plugins.description: Double-entry bookkeeping for agent harnesses, as two skills: a runtime ledger (balanced state changes, tool-call intents cleared against code-measured probes, Claude Code hooks, multi-agent budgets that must net to zero) and a landing ledger (design decisions as debits, one voucher per debit from the implementer, mechanical checks and a high-precision gate, reverse scan for unwired code).
